label: Blind Emboss / Deboss
text: Blind emboss look: uninked white relief pressed into paper, forms visible only by shadow and raking light, tactile white-on-white surface, no colour.

label: Thermal Receipt Print
text: Thermal print look: faded black heat-printed marks on glossy white paper, low contrast, patchy fading, monochrome, cheap printer texture.

label: Dot Matrix Print
text: Dot matrix print look: images built from tiny pin-struck dots, uneven ink density from a worn ribbon, faint horizontal banding, black ink only.

label: Flexography / Package Print
text: Flexographic package print look: bold saturated inks on corrugated board, simple flat colour areas, slight registration halos, commercial packaging texture.

label: Gravure / Rotogravure
text: Rotogravure print look: rich saturated continuous-tone colour, smooth coated glossy paper, fine cell screen, magazine print quality.

label: Pad Printing
text: Pad print look: thin crisp ink transfer on a smooth glossy surface, flat single colours, precise small shapes, manufactured product finish.

label: Embroidery Patch / Merrowed Edge
text: Embroidered patch look: dense satin-stitch thread filling, raised embroidered thread texture, bold simple shapes in thread, twill fabric backing, thick stitched border.

label: Woven Label / Damask
text: Woven label look: everything made of tightly woven fine thread, damask weave texture, limited thread colours, small crisp woven detail.

label: Edge Painting / Gilding
text: Gilded look: burnished gold and silver leaf, concentrated reflected light, textured gilded edges, rich metallic sheen.

label: Die Cut Window
text: Retail packaging look: clean die-cut printed card stock, crisp printed registration, glossy packaging finish, bright commercial colour.

label: Shin-hanga
text: Shin-hanga woodblock look: soft graded bokashi sky, luminous twilight glow, deep indigo and teal palette, delicate keyblock outlines, layered flat colour, paper grain.

label: Swiss / International Typographic
text: Swiss graphic design look: strict grid, flat colour, generous white space, black and white with a single flat red accent, clean objective modernist layout.

label: Psychedelic Poster
text: Psychedelic poster look: vibrating complementary colours, swirling organic linework, orange against magenta and acid green, dense allover ornament, molten flowing shapes.

label: Islamic Geometric
text: Islamic geometric look: interlacing star polygon strapwork, precise compass-drawn geometry, tessellating tile patterns, gold, lapis and turquoise palette.

label: Chiaroscuro Woodcut
text: Chiaroscuro woodcut look: two or three flat tone blocks over a black keyblock line, hard stepped tonal bands, highlights cut to bare paper, warm olive or sepia ink.

label: Sōsaku-hanga
text: Sosaku-hanga print look: vigorous visible gouge marks, expressive modernist simplification, bold flat colour with rough registration, woodgrain printed into the ink.

label: Patent Drawing
text: Patent drawing look: black ink lines on white, tone only from ruled hatching, uniform stroke weight, thin numbered lead lines, clean technical rendering.

label: Anatomical Plate
text: Anatomical plate look: precise engraved lines, fine cross-hatch modelling, aged cream paper with foxing, restrained hand-tinted wash, clinical clarity.

label: Wanted Poster
text: Old west poster look: letterpress on coarse tea-stained rag paper, foxed edges, coarse stipple printing, heavy black ink, worn vintage print.

label: Penny Dreadful
text: Penny dreadful look: crude wood-engraved illustration, heavy black shadows, cheap yellowed pulp paper, coarse broken ink, lurid two-colour printing.

label: WPA Poster
text: WPA poster look: flat screen-printed colour in a limited palette, simplified monumental shapes, hard-edged geometric shadow blocks, slight ink misregistration.

label: Chromolithograph
text: Chromolithograph look: dense flat saturated inks from many layered stones, hand-stippled tonal transitions, fine key outline, slight plate misregistration.

label: Pochoir Stencil Print
text: Pochoir stencil look: flat opaque gouache colour shapes with crisp edges, faint brushed texture inside each, colour slightly straying past edges, matte paper.

label: Type Specimen Sheet
text: Type specimen look: strict baseline grid, generous margins, crisp black type on cream paper, two-colour printing, bold cropped graphic shapes.

label: Broadside
text: Broadside look: uneven letterpress inking, blotted and starved woodtype impressions, heavy black rules, coarse cream paper, crowded vintage printing.

label: Fraktur / Blackletter
text: Blackletter print look: dense dark angular strokes, heavy page colour, decorative flourishes, black ink on aged paper, old German printing feel.

label: Bollywood Hand-Painted Poster
text: Hand-painted Bollywood poster look: enamel-bright saturated colour, airbrushed skin with hard painted highlights, visible brush texture, overlapping montage feel.

label: Isotype Pictogram
text: Isotype pictogram look: flat uniform silhouette shapes repeated in even rows, restricted palette of black, vermilion and blue-grey, generous white ground.

label: Blacklight Poster
text: Blacklight poster look: fluorescent electric magenta, lime and cyan glowing against a deep black velvet ground, heavy black keylines, flat fills.

label: Film One-Sheet
text: Modern film poster look: dramatic photographic composite, teal and orange colour grade, hard rim light glow, dark moody cinematic contrast.

label: Low-Poly
text: Low-poly 3D look: flat-shaded geometric facets, visible triangulated mesh, one colour per face, crisp angular edges.

label: Voxel Art
text: Voxel art look: everything built from uniform cubes, chunky block forms, flat bright colours, soft ambient occlusion.

label: Clay Render
text: Clay render look: matte uniform clay material, soft pastel monochrome, smooth rounded surfaces, soft studio shadows.

label: Wireframe
text: Wireframe look: thin glowing mesh edge lines on black, visible topology, unshaded open faces, technical CAD feel.

label: Photoreal 3D
text: Photoreal 3D render look: ray-traced global illumination, physically-based materials, micro-surface detail, caustics, crisp realistic light.

label: Cel-Shaded 3D
text: Cel-shaded 3D look: bold black outlines, flat colour zones with hard shadow edges, toon lighting, saturated colour.

label: Isometric Pixel Art
text: Isometric pixel art look: crisp visible pixels on a diamond grid, limited palette, clean parallel projection, no anti-aliasing.

label: 8-Bit Pixel Art
text: 8-bit pixel art look: severely limited palette, big chunky visible pixels, dithering, flat retro console graphics.

label: 16-Bit Pixel Art
text: 16-bit pixel art look: detailed pixel sprites, expanded retro palette, subtle colour gradation within pixels, crisp edges.

label: Vector Flat Design
text: Flat vector look: bold simplified geometric shapes, flat colour fields meeting edge to edge, no outlines, no texture, clean modern palette.

label: 3D Matte Painting
text: 3D environment render look: physically based materials under global illumination, epic atmospheric depth, volumetric haze, cinematic light.

label: Digital Oil Painting
text: Digital oil painting look: thick impasto-style brush strokes, visible directional strokes, rich blended colour, painterly finish.

label: Photobashing
text: Photobash concept look: photographic textures painted over to unify, mixed-resolution detail, loose painted edges, cinematic colour.

label: Kitbashing
text: Kitbash look: greebled mechanical surface detail, industrial sci-fi panels and pipes, grey metal with accent colours, hard-surface render.

label: Blender Donut Aesthetic
text: Friendly 3D render look: clean Cycles render, warm studio lighting, slightly oversaturated glossy colours, smooth subdivided forms.

label: Subsurface Scattering Render
text: Subsurface scattering look: translucent glowing materials, soft wax-like skin, warm light bleeding through thin edges.

label: NPR/Non-Photorealistic Render
text: Stylized 3D render look: 3D forms shaded like traditional media, painted brushstroke or hatching shaders, watercolour edge bleed.

label: Particle System Render
text: Particle render look: forms made of thousands of tiny glowing particles, swirling dust, embers and sparks, dark background.

label: Motion Graphics 3D
text: Motion graphics look: clean geometric 3D shapes, bold flat colours with glossy material, soft gradient background, playful polished render.

label: Ray Traced Render
text: Ray-traced render look: sharp mirror reflections, refractive glass, physically accurate shadows, glossy materials.

label: Ambient Occlusion Pass
text: Ambient occlusion look: white matte surfaces, soft grey contact shadows in crevices, no colour, soft even light.

label: ZBrush Sculpt Render
text: Digital sculpt look: uniform matte grey or red clay material, extremely fine sculpted surface detail, soft studio light.

label: Real-Time Render / Game Engine
text: Game engine look: real-time rendered lighting, screen-space reflections, bloom, slightly game-like textures, crisp modern graphics.

label: Volumetric Render
text: Volumetric render look: god rays and light shafts through fog and dust, atmospheric density, glowing haze.

label: Fractal Art / Mandelbrot
text: Fractal art look: infinite self-similar swirling patterns, glowing gradient colour bands, mathematical recursive detail.

label: Generative AI Image
text: Early AI art look: soft painterly diffusion texture, dreamy over-smooth detail, saturated glossy colour, slight surreal artefacts.

label: Displacement Mapping
text: Displacement render look: deep physical surface grooves and ridges, exaggerated relief, raking light on heavy texture.

label: HDRI Environment Lighting
text: HDRI lit render look: natural environment reflections, physically accurate soft light, glossy reflective materials.

label: Photogrammetry
text: Photogrammetry scan look: realistic scanned surface textures, slightly melted soft geometry, baked-in natural lighting.

label: Particle Hair / Fur
text: Rendered fur look: thousands of fine individual hair strands, soft clumping, realistic fur sheen.

label: Fluid Simulation
text: Fluid simulation look: glossy simulated liquid splashes frozen in time, foam and droplets, refractive clear surfaces.

label: Cloth Simulation
text: Cloth simulation look: realistic simulated draping fabric, soft wrinkles and folds, smooth rendered textile.

label: Soft Body Dynamics
text: Soft body render look: squishy rubbery elastic surfaces, glossy jelly-like materials, bouncy deformed forms.

label: Synthwave
text: Synthwave look: glowing magenta and cyan neon, retro 1980s grid glow, chrome reflections, purple dusk gradient, scanline haze.

label: ASCII Art
text: ASCII art look: the whole image made of monospaced text characters, tone from character density, green or white on black.

label: Teletext
text: Teletext look: chunky block mosaic cells, seven pure saturated colours plus black, hard rectangular edges, low resolution.

label: Plotter Pen Drawing
text: Pen plotter look: uniform machine-drawn ink lines, hatching and spiral fills, single ink colour on white paper.

label: Flow Field
text: Flow field art look: thousands of fine flowing line trails following a vector field, sweeping laminar curves, generative art palette.

label: Reaction-Diffusion
text: Reaction-diffusion look: organic labyrinthine stripes and spots, branching maze patterns, two-tone generative texture.

label: Voronoi Cells
text: Voronoi look: surfaces divided into irregular convex cells, crisp cell boundaries, flat colour per cell, generative pattern.

label: Truchet Tiles
text: Truchet tile look: forms built from rotated quarter-arc tiles, meandering connected curves, two-colour generative pattern.

label: Point Cloud / LiDAR Scan
text: Point cloud look: forms described by discrete glowing points in black space, density thinning with depth, LiDAR scan feel.

label: PS1-Era Real-Time
text: PS1-era 3D look: chunky low-poly geometry, warping low-resolution textures, vertex jitter, dithered colour, no texture filtering.

label: Depth Pass
text: Depth pass look: smooth greyscale gradient where near is white and far is black, no texture, no colour.

label: Normal Pass
text: Normal map look: surface orientation as colour, lavender-blue faces turning red and green at the sides, smooth gradients.

label: Metaball / Marching Cubes
text: Metaball look: rounded blobby merging volumes, smooth glossy surfaces, soft studio lighting.

label: SDF Raymarch
text: Raymarched SDF look: infinitely repeated geometry in black, soft analytic ambient occlusion, glowing fog, crisp mathematical forms.

label: Y2K Chrome
text: Y2K chrome look: liquid mercury chrome surfaces, sharp specular highlights, blobby bevelled forms, iridescent reflections, silver and blue.

label: Frutiger Aero
text: Frutiger Aero look: glossy translucent aqua surfaces, beaded water, high-key cyan and leaf green, soft airbrushed glow, 2000s optimism.

label: 1-Bit Monochrome
text: 1-bit look: pure black and white pixels only, ordered dither patterns for every tone, chunky visible pixels, no grey.

label: Gaussian Splat
text: Gaussian splat look: forms made of overlapping soft translucent blobs, fuzzy dissolving edges, photographic colour.

label: Demoscene
text: Demoscene look: banded copper bar gradients, swirling plasma colour fields, chunky retro pixels, cycling saturated palette.
